facts.text: I am looking for new running shoes.
I finished a 5K run with a personal best time of 27 minutes and 42 seconds.
I think it is time to upgrade my running gear.
I land midfoot when I run.
I plan to use the Nike Vaporfly Next% for speed workouts and shorter races.
I need a more durable shoe for my regular training runs.
My weekly mileage is around 60 to 70 miles.
I am thinking of getting the Brooks Ghost.
I have heard the Brooks Ghost is heavier than some other shoes.
I am not sure whether the weight of a shoe will affect my performance.
